title: Full billing, reporting, retention và cost economics

scope_items.title: Cancellation differs from dunning across trial, pause, dunning (Day 0/1/3/7/14 -> Free auto-downgrade), and voluntary cancellation (Phase 1 0-30d read-only quarantine, Phase 2 30-90d soft-delete, Phase 3 90d+ hard erase)

Purchased credits preserved across monthly cycle resets, dunning auto-downgrade to Free, subscription pause/resume, and Phase 1/2 quarantine/restore; all 6 payment methods behind access gates, 4 Starter+ add-ons with mid-cycle proration, and Overage Mode toggle

Restore, export (JSON/CSV/ZIP with 7-day signed R2 URL and SHA-512 checksum), and Right-to-Erasure cryptographic evidence with EC-M23-002 multi-member owner guard and 7y/5y/3y anonymized financial/audit retention

Measured cohort economics (all 7 canonical metrics: Gross Margin %, NRR %, Blended CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC Payback Months, AI Cost per Active Workspace) and complete financial/tax reports with BIZ-007 disclaimer and tier export limits

verified_sub_slices: PostgreSQL migration 00040 for export_jobs, referral_records, api_call_logs, chargebacks, platform_fee_schedules, and performance_reports with RLS + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and narrow role grants
Payment method access gates across Stripe Card, MoMo Wallet, ZaloPay, VNPay QR/ATM, PayPal, and Bank Transfer (Enterprise Annual) plus EC-M23-001 last payment method guard
Starter+ add-on purchase/detach with exact mid-cycle proration (NUMERIC(18,6) / BigInt micro-units) and Overage Mode opt-in toggle
14-day Pro trial lifecycle (1 per email/card fingerprint, 100 trial credits, Day-12 warning, Day-14 conversion or Free downgrade) and subscription pause (1-3 months, max once/year, $5/mo retention)
Dunning retry schedule (Day 0, +24h, +72h, +168h, Day 7-14 read-only grace, Day 14 auto-downgrade to Free) strictly distinct from voluntary cancellation 30/60/90-day retention phases
DataService export/restore/erase flows with SHA-512 evidence, 7-day export URL TTL, EC-M23-002 multi-member deletion guard, and 7y/5y/3y anonymized retention
ProfitService financial reports, tax export with BIZ-007 creator_responsible disclaimer, tier export limits (Free=0, Starter=5/mo, Pro+=unlimited), and all 7 canonical cohort economics metrics
Web (/settings/billing) and Mobile (M045/M061) interactive billing, retention, export/erase, and cohort economics labs
